component.name: Markdown-Magic
component.summary: A distraction-free Markdown editor with a live Preview Pane

description.p: Markdown-Magic is a cross-platform, distraction-free Markdown editor for desktop. It pairs a CodeMirror source pane with a live rendered Preview Pane, native Open/Save dialogs, and full keyboard-driven editing.
Documents opened from the file manager load into their own Tab, and relative images render right next to the Markdown source in the Preview Pane.
